# One leg of the footballer (knee, sock, boot), its origin at the hip (z 0.60): the scene swings
# it about that point. Generated by make_player.py.
new
add mesh cube --name Boot --size 1 --location 0.000 -0.045 0.065
scale 0.200 0.300 0.130
apply --scale
add mesh cube --name Sock --size 1 --location 0.000 0.000 0.230
scale 0.160 0.190 0.200
apply --scale
add mesh cube --name Knee --size 1 --location 0.000 0.000 0.475
scale 0.160 0.190 0.290
apply --scale
material new Skin --base-color 1.000 0.643 0.408 --no-slot
material new Sock --base-color 0.925 0.380 0.290 --no-slot
material new Boot --base-color 0.220 0.000 0.173 --no-slot
select Boot
material assign Boot
select Sock
material assign Sock
select Knee
material assign Skin
select all
active Knee
join
rename Knee Leg
cursor set 0 0 0.6
origin set --to cursor
set location 0 0 0
scale 0.96 0.84 1.00
apply --scale
shade flat
export player_leg.glb
